checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images delivered, no extra cover/closing slide
must.why: Only four 4:5 slides are visible (tips 1–4). The fifth image is a blank square background, not a slide. The 'Take a short break' slide is not among the files.

must.item: Five supplied tips appear verbatim in order
must.why: Tips 1–4 are verbatim and in order. 'Take a short break' does not appear.
Numbers 1–4 are visible in circles. There is no 5.

must.item: Each slide has a relevant illustration
must.why: Slides 1–4 have relevant icons: desk with lamp, phone with muted bell, check with lines, stopwatch. Slide 5 is not visible. The icons are very small.

must.item: Shared clean blue-and-white design with readable, unclipped text
must.why: Text is readable and unclipped, and the palette is consistent. The layout is not consistent: slide 3 has no border frame, and slide 4 has its content crammed at the top with a large empty bottom half.

exact_text.read_as: not present in any delivered image

faults.what: The fifth slide, 'Take a short break' with the number 5 and a coffee cup, is not among the images. Only four slides are present.
A blank square background image is included. It is not 4:5 and would count as an extra slide.
Slide 4 has its content at the top and the bottom half empty. The layout is unbalanced.
Inconsistent design: the border frame appears on slides 1 and 2 but not on slides 3 and 4. Content position varies between slides.
The illustrations are tiny, especially the checkmark icon on slide 3, which is a weak match for 'pick one task'. Large empty space surrounds them.
The muted-bell icon on slide 2 is cluttered with a crossed-out X over the phone and bell.

summary: The text on slides 1–4 is correct and numbered, but slide 5 is missing, a blank square background was delivered in its place, and the layouts are inconsistent, with slide 4 top-heavy.
